The support has valuation layers \(dj\) and \(dj+1\) and dyadic Haar measure \(2^{1-h}/(1-2^{-d})\). value.rationale: The natural local Waring question asks which dyadic integers are sums of exactly two high even powers and how representations distribute, crucial at the prime two where high powers are highly singular. The theorem gives the full uniform t-parameter image, exact all-target prime-power counts and a nontrivial explicit rational Haar measure, including \(2/15\) for quartics. It is a complete natural local classification, not a selected numerical example or merely the known unit subgroup lemma; the residual possibility of implicit prior derivation is recognized.
